title: HYDROGEN
description:
Hydrogen is a Roguelite Action Game In a Sci-Fi post-apocalyptic landscape where humanity teeters on the brink, you step into the boots of a fearless Mercenary with a mission to rescue the world from impending doom.
Procedural generated instances, offering a fresh and unpredictable challenge each time you play.
Level up your Mercenary with perks at every turn, enhancing your abilities and customizing your playstyle.Elemental Attacks :-Physical : Raw Damage
-Fire : Damage over time that scales with Player Power
-Acid : Damage over time that scales with Enemy Health
-Electric : Multi Target Damage that scales with Power
-Frost : Stuns Enemies
-Void : Knocks Back EnemiesParrying Attacks :Performing a parry reflects the exact enemy attack!

Dashing makes the player invulnerable to damage during the dash.
description_short: Enter a post-apocalyptic Sci-Fi world in Hydrogen a thrilling Action Roguelite. Navigate through procedurally generated instances, each playthrough offering unique challenges, random items, and perks to level up your character.
